# Yusuf Isa

> Yusuf Isa is an independent web designer and front-end developer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. He designs and builds clear, considered websites, product interfaces and identity systems for small teams.

Canonical: https://yusufisa.my/
Contact: hello@yusufisa.my
Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Availability: Booking select projects for Q1 2027
Response time: Usually within two working days
Last updated: 2026-10-20

## About

Yusuf works independently with founders, studios and small teams. His work sits between design and engineering: setting the typography and content, designing the interface, then building the front end properly. He prefers quiet, useful websites over loud ones.

## Services

- Website design and front-end development
- Product interface design
- Identity systems
- Design direction and content structure

## Selected work

- Rumah (2026) — A neighbourhood-first rental search. Product design and build.
- Kira (2025) — A calmer home for freelance money. Brand and interface.
- Jalan (2025) — A travel journal for the long way round. Editorial and web.

Case studies are available by email.

## Common questions

### What does Yusuf Isa do?

He is an independent web designer and front-end developer. He designs and builds websites, product interfaces and identity systems for small teams.

### Where is he based?

Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. He works remotely with teams anywhere and can meet in Kuala Lumpur when useful.

### Is he available for new projects?

He is currently booking select projects for Q1 2027. Send a note with your timeline to check whether it is a fit.

### How do you start a project?

Email hello@yusufisa.my with what you are building, who it is for and your rough timeline. Replies usually arrive within two working days.
